description: Prepared and verified a committed, unsent CAD 120 one-cohort licensing inquiry for BrainStation Toronto using the tested SQLite exercise. Purchasing interest and supplier intake remain unverified. Commercial feedback shows no newly interpreted requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue. The training lead can advance through rights, form-terms and prior-contact checks before an operator send decision.
